parsed.why: No state facility ban; gender-identity discrimination banned by rule and commission interpretation, municipal ordinances, city care-sanctuary order; sports bills vetoed. Offset: no statewide hate-crime recourse. National border/document and custody exposure caps it.

Statewide public-facility ban (restrooms, changing rooms, sleeping quarters) with private cause of action, no nondiscrimination or hate-crime protection, rated among the worst for anti-trans adult legislation. Universal birth-sex exclusion unremedied.

Birth-sex restroom rule extended to colleges and universities, no state hate-crime statute, prison treatment freeze-frame, unrepealed dead-letter sodomy provision. Narrower adult reach than 2 or 5, but no working recourse documented.

Most Protective tier: public-accommodations and hate-crime coverage, self-declared markers, care shield protecting visiting patients. Unenforced 1974-barred sodomy wording is a dead letter. National border and custody regime still caps it.

Birth-sex exclusion in schools and government buildings, enforced by resident complaint forms, with a surgical-documentation defence visitors cannot meet and no alternative route. Hate-crime recourse and partial nondiscrimination offset somewhat.
